exposure: spontaneous labour onset with vaginal birth (SLVB)
outcome: Spontaneous labour onset with vaginal birth (SLVB)
cohort: 229,757 women birthing in public hospitals of the Australian State of Queensland during two periods, 2011-2013 and 2016-2018
finding: Increased gestational diabetes diagnoses did not improve birth outcomes and were associated with an increase in medical interventions such as induction of labor and a decrease in spontaneous vaginal births.
mod_finding: Increased gestational diabetes diagnoses led to an increase in inductions of labor and planned births, and a decrease in spontaneous labor onset with vaginal birth.
